protocol.fixed: Same .45 s observation warmup; open-loop .15 acceleration for first 2 s then .30. No cargo-magnitude-based cruise/acceleration or warning-edge redecision. Common route geometry, goal braking and measured >5 mm budget stop retained.
protocol.reactive: Existing zero-mean policy: same measured guards, settling/restart candidates, short-variant calibration and ranking with predicted mean zero. No learned mean used.
protocol.learned: Existing fixed short-model policy with measured guards; weights, calibration and selection unchanged.
protocol.design: 54 fresh acquisitions: three methods x three previously evaluated cargo combinations x two routes x three paired seeds. Protocol frozen before acquisition. Not a new holdout-cargo test; no tuning from outcomes.
protocol.limitation: Safety/budget stop is common even to fixed motion. This is not literal absence of all feedback: path tracking is present in every method. Time is stepped simulation time. Three seeds are not independent real-world trials.

caveat: Means over successful arrivals exclude stopped runs. Compare paired/common-success times and success counts together; do not treat stop time as delivery time.
